case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised attentive, friendly staff and frequent complimentary treats (snacks, sweets, afternoon drinks), with multiple mentions of helpful concierge, free guided city tour, and spa/massage services. Reviews highlighted clean, comfortable rooms, central location, high-quality breakfast and restaurant. Several reviews explicitly reported no dislikes or that everything was perfect, with no recurring negative comments in the supplied feedback.
